INC-1041 Cold-storage freezer F-3 temperature excursion
[Synthetic example written for this benchmark; all names, numbers and events are fictional.]

On 4 March the -80 C freezer F-3 in Building C rose to -52 C for about 40 minutes after a compressor relay stuck open. Samples were moved to F-5. Cause: failed compressor relay. The relay was replaced and the alarm threshold lowered to -70 C.

INC-1057 Cold-room door alarm failure
[Synthetic example written for this benchmark; all names, numbers and events are fictional.]

The cold room door was left ajar overnight on 19 March and the door alarm did not sound. Room temperature reached 11 C. Cause: alarm contact misaligned after a door hinge repair. The contact was realigned and is now tested weekly.
